🔄 Content updated (published October 27, 2026 / previously listed September 22, 2026)
Main change: The course distance has been adjusted from approximately 8 kilometers to approximately 7.8 kilometers.

We are holding the "First Maple Leaf Walk," a guided walk through the autumn countryside and rural areas of the Seimei District. (Note: This replaces the 51st Seimei District Walking Rally, which has been renamed.)

【Date and Time】Monday, November 23, 2026 (Reiwa 8), National Holiday. Assembly at 8:15 a.m.

【Assembly Point】Seimei District Administrative Center

【Course】Seimei District Administrative Center → through Okokubo, Hiramatsu, and Ashikariba areas → through Futayanagi and Okokubo areas → National Route 299 Bypass → through Aoki and Nakai areas → Nakai Tourism Public Restroom (rest stop) → Miyazawa Lake and Metsa Village (rest stop) → through Miyazawa, Shimokaji, and Okokubo areas → return to Seimei District Administrative Center

【Distance】Approximately 7.8 kilometers

【Planned Duration】Approximately 3 hours

【Cost】Free

【What to Bring】Drinking water, rain gear, Sogo-Ashi handbook (if you have one)

【How to Apply】Apply to one of the district administrative centers listed below by Wednesday, November 11, 2026:
• Seimei District Administrative Center — Phone: 042-972-2314, Fax: 042-972-9804, Email: seimei-k@city.hanno.lg.jp
• Futayanagi District Administrative Center — Phone: 042-972-9900, Fax: 042-972-9902, Email: nami-k@city.hanno.lg.jp

【Checking for Cancellation】If weather or other conditions cause cancellation, please call the Seimei District Administrative Center between 7:30 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. on the day of the event to confirm.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/13339.html
summary: ℹ️ Sogo-Ashi Event: First Maple Leaf Walk, November 23, 2026 (Monday, National Holiday)
